_comment: Seed catalog for ORBITAL SURPLUS. Prices in cents (USD). `inventory` is starting stock per size; it is copied into Postgres on first boot and managed from /admin after that.

products.name: Perigee Moto Jacket
products.description:
Cut for the closest point of the orbit. The Perigee is a cropped moto in high-gloss faux leather with an asymmetric front zip that runs from the hem to a notched lapel.

A cinch belt sits low on the waist, both cuffs zip open, and two angled pockets keep tools within reach in low gravity. It's shaped close to the body so it layers under a suit liner without bunching.

Inside: a slick lining, one zipped interior pocket and a printed docking-bay manifest on the hanger loop.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth
Store away from direct sunlight (and solar flares)

products.name: Apogee Bomber
products.description:
Built for the far end of the orbit. A straight-fit bomber in faux leather pressed with a hexagonal hull texture, finished with knit rib at the collar, cuffs and hem.

Three reflective rings on each sleeve pick up station lighting. Flap pockets and a welt chest pocket keep the front clean, and the full-length zip runs up into the collar.

The hex emboss is deep enough to read across a docking bay and soft enough to wear every shift.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth
Store flat or on a wide hanger

products.name: Reentry Puffer
products.description:
Flight-orange so the recovery crew can find you. The Reentry is a boxy puffer with horizontal baffles from collar to hem and quilted sleeves that keep their loft when compressed into a locker.

Knit cuffs and a rib hem seal out the draught, the stand collar zips right up, and a matte black patch on the chest takes a crew name tag.

Filled with recycled synthetic insulation that stays warm when it's damp, and packs into its own pocket.
care: Tumble dry low with dryer balls to restore loft

products.name: Tether Shell
products.description:
A three-layer hooded shell for wet decks and worse. Every seam is taped in signal lime so you can see the build, and the hood has a stiffened peak with lime toggle cords.

An angled chest zip, two hand-warmer pockets and hook-and-loop cuffs. The dropped back hem keeps you covered when you're bent over a hatch.

Waterproof, windproof and breathable, with a soft brushed backer that's quiet when you move.
care: Machine wash cold with technical wash
Tumble dry low to reactivate DWR

products.name: Ballast Field Jacket
products.description:
Four pockets, no wasted mass. The Ballast is a heavy cotton-twill field jacket in habitat olive, with two bellowed chest pockets, two big cargo pockets and a snap on every flap.

A button placket closes over the zip, the stand-fall collar flips up against the wind, and a drawcord at the waist pulls the shape in. There's a utility pocket on the left sleeve sized for a pen or a torch.

Garment-washed, so it feels broken in from the first shift.

products.name: Drift Coach Jacket
products.description:
The off-shift layer. A light coach jacket in deep-space navy nylon with a snap front, a turn-down collar and a drawcord hem with lime toggles.

On the left chest, a small printed orbit mark. Welt hand pockets, knit-backed cuffs and a mesh lining let it breathe in the warm sections of the station.

Light enough to stuff in a bag, smart enough for the commissary.
